source_notes: Municipal FY2026/27 budget Annexure B calls its schedule proposed and states that a 6 c/kWh network surcharge, 2% business/large-power-user surcharge, and VAT are excluded.

Augos secondary machine-readable schedule lists a 0.06 ZAR/kWh DSM levy and seasonal energy rates. The 6 c/kWh surcharge and the 6 c/kWh DSM levy are not assumed to be identical. Their reconciliation and applicability must be resolved before total-bill claims.

Fixed-charge interpretation conflict: the municipal FY2026/27 schedule presents one charge pair for Business Conventional & Prepaid 400 V up to 100 kVA, and the independent Focal Energy cross-check labels these R890.45/month service plus R853.72/month capacity charge. Augos lists separate <50 kVA and >50-to-100 kVA fixed charge bands, and labels R853.72 as monthly network charge; it lists lower values R816.85/R783.16 for the upper band. Do not use Augos's upper-band values or infer the second component's legal/accounting label until the official schedule/account bill reconciles them.

deliberately_unapplied_charges.reason: Budget Annexure B says excluded; applicability and reconciliation against the secondary DSM levy have not been verified.
Secondary source lists a DSM levy. Do not assume it is or is not identical to the municipal 6 c/kWh network surcharge until source mapping is confirmed.
Budget Annexure B says excluded; base, applicability and calculation order require confirmation.
VAT is excluded from the schedule. Not hardcoded here; treatment depends on actual billing/claim basis.
Only the stated candidate conventional low-voltage fee structure is represented; account-specific charges require confirmation.

Augos secondary source splits fixed charges by <50 kVA and >50-to-100 kVA and labels the second component network charge; the municipal schedule and Focal cross-check show one <=100 kVA pair and label it capacity charge. The candidate calculator uses the common <=100 kVA amounts only and does not use the disputed alternative band/label.

claim_ceiling: Exact energy-block arithmetic and two published monthly fixed-amount fields for a candidate <=100 kVA Business Conventional schedule only; the identity/label of the second fixed charge and the Augos upper-capacity bands remain unresolved. Not a complete bill, not an account quote, and not a tariff/legal interpretation.
